change: The shared changes_since API uses independently bounded structural history for membership-only readers. Same ECS revision sequence and writer barrier; general component value readers retain existing semantics.
tradeoff: Up to 16384 additional compact revision/entity entries per ECS world, allocated incrementally; structural overflow still requests a reset.

macQualification.description: 10000 spatial entities, 1000 render records, 60 extraction samples per mode; dense_churn creates and destroys one temporary entity before dense pose writes. Includes per-extract membership candidate counts.
